newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis to reaffirm confidence in 1999 EMU launch.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis to reaffirm confidence in 1999 EMU launch.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday he was confident European monetary union would be launched on time in January 1999.

"I will reaffirm my conviction that we will be there on January 1, 1999," he told reporters as he arrived in the central French town of Lyon for talks with German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and French and German central bank heads Jean-Claude Trichet and Hans Tietmeyer
Arthuis had been asked whether he expected to reaffirm the 1999 launch date for the new euro single currency.

The meeting, part of a regular series between the finance ministers and central bankers of Europe's two biggest economies, takes place amid resurgent speculation of a delay to the launch of economic and monetary union.

Speculation about a delay has been fuelled by worries that Germany may be unable to cut its budget deficit to three percent of gross domestic product this year in line with Maastricht treaty requirements for entry to a single currency.
